listing.name: Nuclear Weapons!
listing.summary: This mod adds nuclear weapons that deal incredible amounts of damage (unrealistic but who cares). It is included in the missile package bp.
listing.aiSummary: Adds nuclear weapons that deal incredible amounts of damage.

description:
This mod adds nuclear weapons that deal incredible amounts of damage (unrealistic but who cares). It is included in the missile package bp.

Forgive me, but I have no idea how to post an image. The missile sprite and most of the code reuses that of the vanilla reaper. thank you, kind Killer of Fate!

FAQ

Isn't it just a more powerful reaper? Yeah, but I'd like to pretend that it's not.
Is it balanced? Nope
Will I add more? I hope too
Will you change the sprite? I can't sprite, so I don't think so. Even the missile itself is just a kitbash of code stolen from the reaper.
Why did you make this mod? I wanted a nuclear weapon that was more powerful than the reaper. Simple as.
Do you accept feedback? Of course. At the end of the day, this is just for fun.

Download it here:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SzU0lAV6_9qC8t2V0eQE5abYY72rlLPe/view?usp=sharing

ps. Now, here me out. What if, wait. Hold on. What if you strapped an ICBM on a mount? Now that would be something.

Changelog: 0.2 - Added 30 Megaton ICBM (Guided Nuke)
